text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Moroccan government condemns as a savage and inhuman act the death of Moroccan-born Loubna Benaissa, who disappeared five years ago and whose body was found last week.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri holds meetings with officials on strengthening state institutions and on the revision of electoral lists.
- Royal Air Maroc carried 12,529 people to Saudi Arabia to undertake the haj during the month of Ramadan.
- Belgium pays last homage to Loubna Benaissa who is to be buried on Sunday in Tangiers.
- European Commission grants Morocco nearly 1.3 billion dirhams to support its economic reforms.
- World congress on maternal mortality to open in Marrakesh.
- World water forum to be held in Marrakesh to look into problems surrounding supplies of water in the world today and challenges for the 21st century.
- French newspaper le Monde guilty of offending King Hassan in a report.
